item.title: Iran's women's football team returns to 'hero's welcome' after asylum drama
item.description: As thousands gathered with Iranian flags, football officials praised the team's loyalty to the 'revolution' despite earlier reports of attempted defections.

item.title: US lawmakers push back against $200 billion Iran war funding request
item.description: Democrats and some Republicans ask for answers regarding additional funding after record defence spending.

item.title: Iran fires wave of missiles as sirens sound in parts of Israel
item.description: IRGC says attack targeted sites in central and southern Israel, including Tel Aviv and US military bases in the region, claiming it was carried out “with complete success.”

item.title: Qatar Emir and Egypt's Sisi call for de-escalation amid regional tensions
item.description: Meeting between the two leaders in Doha comes amid ongoing Iranian attacks and growing regional instability.

item.title: Israel bans Eid prayers at Al-Aqsa under security pretext
item.description: Occupied East Jerusalem enters Muslim holiday in sorrow as Old City falls silent, shops shuttered.

item.title: EU leaders condemn growing illegal settler violence against Palestinians
item.description: European Council says it opposes Israel’s unilateral expansion in the occupied West Bank, calling for de-escalation across the region.

item.title: Israel reels as Iran war drains $6.4B in just 20 days, costs mount rapidly: report
item.description: Total war budget stands around $12.5 billion, with army preparing to request additional funding, according to Israeli media.

item.title: Australia PM Albanese faces backlash as protesters challenge Israel stance
item.description: Demonstrators interrupted proceedings 15 minutes after Albanese and Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke joined worshippers at Lakemba Mosque in Sydney to mark end of Ramadan.

item.title: Iranian drone strikes set Kuwaiti refinery ablaze as Israel launched new attacks on Tehran
item.description: Iranian drone strikes hit Kuwait’s refinery as Israel launched new attacks on Iran, escalating regional tensions and raising concerns over global energy stability.

item.title: Turkish president urges unity during Eid al-Fitr amid Middle East tensions
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdogan expresses concern about "currently boiling" developments in the Middle East and hopes Eid will strengthen unity and fraternity within Türkiye.
